definitions.explanation: A method or system of cultivating crops, such as organic or traditional farming.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{農法|のうほう}を{試|ため}す。
examples.english: To try a new farming method.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{昔|むかし}からの{農法|のうほう}が{守|まも}られている。
examples.english: In this region, traditional farming methods have been preserved.

examples.japanese: {農薬|のうやく}を{使|つか}わない{有機|ゆうき}{農法|のうほう}は{手間|てま}がかかるが、{安全|あんぜん}な{作物|さくもつ}が{作|つく}れる。
examples.english: Organic farming that uses no pesticides takes effort, but it produces safe crops.

notes:
Compound of {農|のう} (agriculture) + {法|ほう} (method). Refers to a system or approach to cultivation rather than a single task.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有機|ゆうき}{農法|のうほう}: organic farming
- {自然|しぜん}{農法|のうほう}: natural farming (without chemicals or tillage)
- {伝統|でんとう}{的|てき}な{農法|のうほう}: traditional farming methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {栽培|さいばい}: cultivation; growing — the act of raising plants, not the overall method
- {農業|のうぎょう}: agriculture; farming — the whole industry or occupation
